cases.sentence: Когда вы перейдете через Иордан, в ___,  которую Господь ваш Бог дает вам.
cases.translation: When you cross over the Jordan into the land which the Lord your God gives you.
cases.explain: The preposition в (into) with motion governs the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Поставьте большие камни и покройте их ___.
cases.translation: Set up great stones and coat them with plaster.
cases.explain: The verb покройте (coat) takes the instrumental case to show the material.

cases.sentence: Напишите на них все слова этого ___, когда переправитесь.
cases.translation: Write on them all the words of this law when you have crossed over.
cases.explain: The genitive case is used to show possession or relationship between nouns.

cases.sentence: Построй там жертвенник Господу твоему Богу, жертвенник из ___.
cases.translation: Build an altar to the Lord your God, an altar of stones.
cases.explain: The preposition из (out of/from) with the genitive case shows composition.

cases.translation: You shall not use any iron tool on them.
cases.explain: The instrumental case shows the instrument or tool used.

cases.sentence: Приноси там жертвы примирения и веселись в присутствии Господа твоего ___.
cases.translation: You shall sacrifice peace offerings and rejoice before the Lord your God.
cases.explain: The genitive case is used in the phrase Господа...Бога (of the Lord your God).

cases.sentence: Молчи и слушай, Израиль, теперь ты стал народом Господа твоего ___.
cases.translation: Be silent and listen, Israel, today you have become the people of the Lord your God.
cases.explain: The genitive case shows possession: the people belonging to God.

cases.sentence: Проклят человек, который передвинет межевой ___ ближнего своего.
cases.translation: Cursed is the man who removes his neighbor's landmark.
cases.explain: The verb передвинет (removes) takes the accusative case for the direct object.

reading.ru: Жертвенник на горе Гевал. Моисей и старейшины Израиля повелели народу.
reading.question: Who commanded the people to build an altar on Mount Ebal?
options: Moses and the elders of Israel
reading.correct: Moses and the elders of Israel
reading.explain: The passage states 'Моисей и старейшины Израиля повелели народу' (Moses and the elders of Israel commanded the people).

reading.ru: Исполняйте все повеления, которые я даю вам сегодня.
reading.question: What should the people do with the commandments being given?
options: Keep all the commandments being given today
Ignore them and do as they wish
Write them down but not obey
reading.correct: Keep all the commandments being given today
reading.explain: The command is 'Исполняйте все повеления' (Keep all the commandments).

reading.ru: Когда вы перейдете через Иордан, в землю, которую Господь ваш Бог дает вам, тогда поставьте большие камни.
reading.question: What are the Israelites instructed to do when they cross the Jordan?
reading.explain: The instruction is 'поставьте большие камни' (set up great stones).

reading.ru: Молчи и слушай, Израиль, теперь ты стал народом Господа твоего Бога.
reading.question: What status has Israel attained?
options: Israel has become the people of the Lord their God
Israel has become a great military power
Israel has built a great kingdom
reading.correct: Israel has become the people of the Lord their God
reading.explain: The passage states 'ты стал народом Господа твоего Бога' (you have become the people of the Lord your God).

reading.ru: Проклят человек, который сделает извайнного или литого идола.
reading.question: What does God curse regarding idols?
options: Making an engraved or molten idol
reading.correct: Making an engraved or molten idol
reading.explain: The curse is on 'человек, который сделает извайнного или литого идола' (the man who makes an engraved or molten idol).

reading.ru: Проклят человек, который оскорбит отца или мать, и весь народ пусть скажет Аминь.
reading.question: What does God curse regarding family relations?
reading.explain: The curse is 'Проклят человек, который оскорбит отца или мать' (Cursed is he who dishonors his father or mother).
